propositions: CodeQL workflow previously ran weekly (23 4 * * 1) as a backstop for advisories between pushes; after push trigger was removed from main CI, weekly became the primary scan cadence, leaving newly-introduced SAST findings unscanned for up to 7 days.
CodeQL workflow must move to 6-hourly cadence (35 */6 * * *) to replace the original push-on-main frequency and restore intended coverage of newly-landed code.
The stale header comment asserting a 28x cost increase rationale is false because navapbc/rebar is a public repository where CodeQL and Actions minutes are free.

CodeQL's 6-hourly cron (minute 35) must be staggered distinctly from the other three scheduled 6-hourly lanes (test.yml :41, optionality.yml :47, verify-identity.yml :53) to avoid GitHub scheduler congestion.

CodeQL has no push trigger and cannot join the _SIX_HOURLY cohort wholesale because that tuple also drives push-preservation assertions for non-main branches; a separate schedule-only cohort is needed.
Test coverage in test_ci_main_push_policy.py must be retargeted to pin the new 6-hourly cadence while retaining no-push and workflow_dispatch assertions.
